purpose: Round 5 Task 5: start the prospective clock. The IC harness has observed 0 of 24 required monthly periods. This file freezes what the clock measures.

champion.definition: production score as of this commit: band normalization, within-block renormalization, both completeness multipliers, blend advisor_engine.py::blend_research_components, modifier stack

pending_decision.clock_cost_of_promoting_later: all periods accrued to that date
pending_decision.disclosed_side_effect: financials-vs-rest gap widens from +2.8 to +7.9 points because the multipliers partially masked suppression-renormalization inflation, see AUDIT-ROUND-5-FINDINGS.md Task 2
pending_decision.accrued_cost_per_month_of_holding: one month of prospective clock forfeited if promoted later, plus one further month of the champion ranking with Spearman(coverage, score) +0.51 and the 1.87x identical-evidence spread

changes_that_reset_the_clock: any change to champion score semantics: weights, bands, normalization mode, modifier caps, coverage handling, blend formula
changes_that_do_not_reset: data-provider fixes restoring intended inputs (statement enrichment, EDGAR fallback), proven score-identical on a frozen snapshot by regression test
UI, docs, publication gates that withhold rather than alter scores

promotion_criteria_champion_or_challenge.deflated_sharpe: >= 0.95 probability at N=40 trials (Bailey and Lopez de Prado, JPM 40(5), 2014)
promotion_criteria_champion_or_challenge.pbo: <= 0.50 via CSCV when enough periods exist

real_money_criteria.additional: 12 further monthly periods (36 total) with ICIR >= 0.3 and net-of-cost six-factor alpha t >= 2 over the combined prospective record

abandonment_criteria.at_24_periods: ICIR <= 0 or net-of-cost spread <= 0: abandon the residual-alpha claim, reposition the product as descriptive analytics
abandonment_criteria.gray_zone: 0 < ICIR < 0.2: extend once by 12 months, then apply the same rule with no second extension

additional_models.definition: pipeline/swing_signals.py five-leg swing-horizon composite (PEAD/SUE .30, analyst revision .25, high-volume premium .20, 52-week-high proximity .15, short-term reversal .10), scored per swing_signals.SWING_WEIGHTS with neutral imputation of unresolved legs, published to public/data/screens/swing.json
additional_models.why_registered: It has no out-of-sample record of any kind. It was built from published effect sizes and shipped as a screen without a backtest, a deflated Sharpe, a PBO estimate or a cost model, in a repository where the research score carries all four. Rounds 5 and 6 measured that no technical sub-signal clears the noise standard on the as-filed spine, and by effective weight this model is 45% technical (volume, 52-week high, reversal). Until this clock reports, it is a research filter and the app says so.
additional_models.weights_are: declared priors ordered by evidence quality at this horizon, frozen before any measurement on this universe - explicitly not fitted optima and not claims of expected return
additional_models.measured_against: the same promotion_criteria_champion_or_challenger above, with the horizon-appropriate change that the IC is measured at the 2-to-40-session holding window rather than monthly
open_questions_the_clock_must_answer: realized turnover, which no backtest has yet produced - the published cost_model reports round-trip cost per position but annual drag needs the number of round trips a year
whether the analyst-revision leg carries the composite on its own once PEAD is live (pre-fix, with PEAD dead, revision was the highest-rho leg at +0.591)

whether the short-term-reversal leg survives at all in its naive form: Da-Liu-Schaumburg's surviving construct is residual reversal after removing the analyst-revision-explained component, and Nagel conditions the payoff on VIX; this implementation runs raw prior-week return at a flat weight, which is the one configuration both cited papers argue against

whether the book needs sector neutralization: with PEAD live the top decile runs 3.4x Energy and 0.0x Utilities against the universe, an undeclared sector bet that has moved rather than disappeared since the volatility normalization removed the earlier REIT/utility tilt
changes_that_reset_this_clock: any change to leg weights, subfactor definitions, standardization, coverage handling or the negative screen

hash_scope: freeze_hash covers the champion registration and its criteria only; additional_models entries carry their own clock and are appended without rehashing the champion.
